map.计算隧道需风量、控制风速与通风机选型参考: Computes the required tunnel air volume, control air velocity and fan selection reference
map.📖 查看「隧道通风计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the Tunnel Ventilation Calculation user guide
map.控制风速法：需风量 Q = 隧道断面积 × 设计控制风速: Control velocity method: required air volume Q = tunnel cross-sectional area × design control velocity
map.CO稀释法：Q = q·N·L / δ（按 CO 容许浓度反算需风量）: CO dilution method: Q = q · N · L / δ (back-calculating the required air volume from the allowable CO concentration)
map.换气次数 n = Q / (A·L)（次/h）: Air changes n = Q / (A · L) (per hour)
map.💡 一般公路隧道设计风速宜为 2~4 m/s，最大不超过 8 m/s；CO 容许: 💡 The design air velocity for a general road tunnel should be 2~4 m/s and must not exceed 8 m/s; the allowable CO concentration is 100 ppm in normal operation and 150 ppm under traffic congestion.
map.按风速控制（velocity 模式）：需风量 Q=断面积 A×控制风速 v×36: Velocity-controlled (velocity mode): required air volume Q = cross-sectional area A × control velocity v × 3600 (m³/h), with Q ÷ 3600 (m³/s) also given; air changes are estimated as v × 3600 ÷ 100 (i.e. hourly air changes based on a 100 m tunnel section). The tool also gives a
map.参考：按 2 台并联，单台风量=Q÷3600÷2（m³/s）。: reference: with two units in parallel, the air volume per unit = Q ÷ 3600 ÷ 2 (m³/s).
map.按 CO 稀释（CO 模式）：CO 排放总量=单车排放量 q×小时交通量 N×隧: CO dilution (CO mode): total CO emission = emission per vehicle q × hourly traffic volume N × tunnel length L; required air volume Q = q × N × L ÷ δ (δ is the allowable CO concentration, substituted directly as the ppm value); the required control velocity v = Q ÷ 3600 ÷ A and air changes n = v × 3600 ÷ L are then back-calculated.
map.两模式互校与选型：先用风速法得到满足最低风速的风量，再用 CO 法校核稀释有害气: Cross-checking the two modes and selection: first use the velocity method to obtain the air volume that satisfies the minimum velocity, then use the CO method to check the demand for diluting harmful gases, and take the larger of the two as the design air volume; fan selection is determined from the number of units in parallel and an air volume margin (generally a further 1.1~1.2 standby factor).
map.算例：60 m² 断面、控制风速 2.5 m/s 的风速法: Worked example: velocity method for a 60 m² section at a control velocity of 2.5 m/s
map.风速模式输入 A=60 m²、v=2.5 m/s：需风量 Q=60×2.5×36: Velocity mode with A = 60 m² and v = 2.5 m/s: required air volume Q = 60 × 2.5 × 3600 = 540000 m³/h = 150.00 m³/s; air changes = 2.5 × 3600 ÷ 100 = 90.00 per hour; fan selection reference = 75.00 m³/s per unit × 2 units. Another set, A = 80 m² and v = 2.0 m/s → Q = 576000 m³/h = 160.00 m³/s, 72.00 air changes per hour, 80.00 m³/s per unit.
map.CO 模式算出的风量为什么比风速法小很多，能直接用吗？: Why is the air volume from CO mode much smaller than from the velocity method, and can it be used directly?
map.不能直接用。工具的 CO 模式按 Q=q×N×L÷δ 直接代入数值计算：默认 q: No, it cannot be used directly. The CO mode of this tool substitutes values directly into Q = q × N × L ÷ δ: with the defaults q = 0.02, N = 800 vehicles/h, L = 1000 m and δ = 100 it outputs Q = 160 m³/h (0.04 m³/s) and v = 0.001 m/s. Here L is entered in metres and δ as the ppm value, without converting to km and a volume ratio as engineering practice requires (100 ppm = 1 × 10⁻⁴). Using the standard form Q = q × N × L (km) ÷ δ (volume ratio), the same physical conditions give 0.02 × 800 × 1.0 ÷ 1e-4 = 160000 m³/h ≈ 44.4 m³/s. The CO mode result can therefore only be used as a relative comparison on the same basis; for engineering calculations convert to standard units yourself and take the larger of the velocity method result and the code limit.
map.换气次数里的 100 是什么意思？: What does the 100 in the air change calculation mean?
map.工具按 v×3600÷100 估算每小时换气次数，即默认以 100 m 长的洞段: The tool estimates hourly air changes as v × 3600 ÷ 100, i.e. it takes a 100 m long tunnel section as the basis by default (the velocity multiplied by the distance travelled in one hour, divided by the 100 m section length). If the actual ventilation section length differs, convert using v × 3600 ÷ actual section length yourself, otherwise the air change rate will be systematically over- or under-estimated.
